title: Terminal object
description: JSON Schema for a terminal object — an object T in a category C such that for every object A there exists a unique morphism A → T (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3; Awodey 2010 §3.4). The dual of initial-object. Terminal objects are unique up to unique isomorphism when they exist. The schema records the witness via a const-pinned subtree: every terminal-object instance carries the same universal-property tag, by const. This demonstrates const-for-whole-subtrees as a JSON Schema 2020-12 feature.

in-category.description: The name of the category C in which this terminal object lives.

terminal-witness.description: The universal-property witness pinned by const. Every terminal-object instance carries this exact subtree; the const constraint forces uniformity. The witness is not data about a specific morphism inventory — it is the assertion that the universal property holds, recorded as a typed cell.
